name: サブスク自作
oneline: 今のサブスクを洗い出し、自作で置き換えられるか判定する
usage: /subs 洗い出し で請求メールから一覧と月額を作る（範囲を決めたあと）
/subs 判定 で難易度と節約額の表を作る
置き換えると決めたら、出てきた /newtool の1行で09番に作ってもらう
1か月使えたら解約の提案が Desk のタスクに入る。解約は本人が行う
メールなしでも subs.py add で手入力して使える
howToCheck: 洗い出す範囲を決めて、/subs に伝える
出てきた一覧と月額が、実際の支払いと合っているか見る
違うものがあれば /subs に伝えて直してもらう
/subs 判定 と打って、表の難易度と節約額を見る
1か月使えて提案が出ても、解約されていないことをサービス側の画面で見る

blockers.why: どの期間と送信元のメールを読むか決まっていないので、請求メールを読めません。
blockers.needs: 何か月分を見るかと、除外したい送信元を決めて /subs に伝える。Gmail が接続されたセッションで動かす

_en.name: Build your own subscriptions
_en.oneline: Lists your current subscriptions and judges whether you could replace each with your own tool
usage: /subs 洗い出し (scan) builds a list with monthly costs from billing emails (once the scope is set)
/subs 判定 (judge) builds a table of difficulty and savings
Once you decide to replace one, use the /newtool line it gives you to have No. 09 build it
After a month of use, a cancellation suggestion goes into Desk tasks. You cancel it yourself
Without mail, you can enter them by hand with subs.py add
howToCheck: Decide the scope to scan and tell /subs
Check that the list and monthly costs match what you actually pay
If something is wrong, tell /subs and have it fixed
Type /subs 判定 (judge) and look at the difficulty and savings in the table
Even after a month and a suggestion, check on the service's own page that nothing was canceled

blockers.why: It is not decided which period and senders to read, so billing emails cannot be read.
blockers.needs: Decide how many months to look at and which senders to leave out, and tell /subs. Run it in a session with Gmail connected
